misclassified_entities.reason: Contracts calling precompiles are internal EVM execution context. A smart contract or EOA initiating a call to a precompiled contract is part of the internal call stack, not an external entity crossing a trust boundary.
The EVM execution context calling a precompile is internal to the system. It's the same execution environment, not an external entity. The true external entity is whatever submitted the transaction.
Calldata is a data type, not an external entity. The source of the calldata (transaction sender) is the external entity.
The EVM gas context is internal system state, not an external entity. Gas limits are set by transaction senders, which are the actual external entities.
A smart contract invoking a precompile is internal to the EVM. The external entity is whoever deployed or called the contract externally.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Miner or peer node producing/propagating blocks during DAO fork period. Within the 10-block fork window, blocks must contain 'dao-hard-fork' marker in extra_data. Block producers have economic stake but proposed blocks must still pass validation.

trusted_external_entities.name: DAO Token Holder
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Original DAO investor entitled to proportional recovery of funds. Authenticated via Ethereum account ownership. Claims must be calculated based on DAO token holdings, cannot withdraw more than entitled share.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Sender (Gas Operations)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External party submitting transactions that trigger IO-heavy opcodes. EIP-150 repriced EXTCODESIZE, EXTCODECOPY, BALANCE, SLOAD, CALL family, and SELFDESTRUCT to prevent DoS attacks via underpriced operations.

trusted_external_entities.name: SELFDESTRUCT Beneficiary
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Address designated to receive contract balance on SELFDESTRUCT. May or may not exist in state. If new account, 25000 gas penalty applies in addition to 5000 base cost to prevent state bloat attacks.

trusted_external_entities.name: BLS Precompile Caller
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External source providing input data for BLS12-381 precompile operations. Input must be fully validated: input length, Fp/Fp2 encoding (top 16 bytes zero, value < modulus), point on curve, subgroup membership (for MSM/pairing). All validation failures consume all gas.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block header from producer during DAO fork window. Must validate: (1) if block in 10-block window starting at 1,920,000, extra_data must contain b'dao-hard-fork' marker, (2) standard header validation (number, timestamp, gas, difficulty, parent hash). Missing marker = reject block.

DAO token holder initiates withdrawal from recovery contract. Proportional share calculated based on DAO token holdings. Recovery contract at 0xbf4ed7b27f1d666546e30d74d50d173d20bca754 assumed secure.

Transaction triggers EVM opcode execution. Post-Tangerine Whistle (block >= 2,463,000), IO-heavy opcodes repriced: EXTCODESIZE 20->700, EXTCODECOPY 20->700, BALANCE 20->400, SLOAD 50->200, CALL family 40->700. Prevents DoS via underpriced state access.
Beneficiary address in SELFDESTRUCT. If account doesn't exist in state, 25000 gas penalty in addition to 5000 base cost. Prevents state bloat attacks by making account creation expensive.

BLS12-381 precompile input from untrusted source. Validation chain: (1) input length correct, (2) Fp elements: top 16 bytes zero AND value < field modulus, (3) point satisfies curve equation OR is infinity encoding, (4) for MSM/pairing: point in correct subgroup via group_order * P = 0. G1ADD/G2ADD explicitly skip subgroup check. All failures consume all gas.

coverage_gaps: EXT-CONTRACT - Reclassified as internal EVM execution
EXT-EVM-EXECUTION - Reclassified as internal EVM context
EXT-CALLDATA - Reclassified as data type, not entity
EXT-EVM-GAS-CONTEXT - Reclassified as internal system state
EXT-SMART-CONTRACT - Reclassified as internal to EVM
coverage_analysis.note: Multiple EVM-internal concepts (calling contracts, execution contexts, calldata, gas context) reclassified as internal. True external entities are transaction senders and block producers. Jump destination validation (spec_96197de27a1d.json) has no external entities - it's purely internal EVM security mechanism.
